SamenvattingUp for a logistics challenge? Become a full-time Warehouse Employee at Schiphol-Rijk. You check, load, and unload goods and make sure everything ends up in the right place. € 16.70 to € 17.80 gross per hour, with shift allowances up to 200% and room to grow. Good work!Over de functieAs a Warehouse Employee, you are a key link in the logistics operation and make sure everything runs smoothly and efficiently together with your team. Your tasks:
- Checking that shipments are complete
- Carefully checking goods for damage
- Loading and unloading goods
- Making sure everything ends up in the right place

Working with a forklift is part of the job. Don't have a certificate yet? No problem, we provide the training so you can operate it safely.
You work in a diverse team on a roster with three shifts:
- Morning shift: 06:30 – 14:30
- Afternoon shift: 14:30 – 22:30
- Night shift: 22:30 – 06:30

- Vocational (VMBO) level of thinking and working
- Willing to obtain an air freight certificate, which we provide
- Good command of Dutch and/or English
- You can obtain a Certificate of No Objection (VGB), which we will apply for on your behalf. This requires you to have been registered within the EU for at least 8 consecutive years.

These points are very important in order to start working as a Warehouse Employee at Schiphol. We are also interested in who you are. Interested in your talents, background and ideas. Surprise us.
Wat wij bieden- € 16.70 to € 17.80 gross per hour, depending on work experience (including a 2.5% year-end bonus)
- Allowances for evening, night, and weekend shifts from 125% to 140%
- Public holiday allowance of 200%
- Weekly payment
- 8.33% h

Job description: Emirates Cabin Crew are responsible for delivering the Fly Better onboard experience to passengers across our global network. As a member of our Cabin Crew team, you will be the onboard representative of our brand, delivering our signature award-winning service while maintaining world-class safety standards. In the role, you will ensure the safety and comfort of our passengers, manage onboard service and maintain cabin cleanliness throughout each flight. You will respond to passenger requests, working collaboratively with your fellow colleagues to ensure a smooth flight. You will also uphold the highest of service standards in line with the Emirates Fly Better promise. Candidate profile: To be considered for Emirates Cabin Crew, you’ll need to be: Fluent in written and spoken English (additional languages are an advantage) A natural team player with a personality that shines At least 160cm tall and able to reach 212cm high Able to meet the UAE’s employment visa requirements At least 21 years old And have: At least 1 year of hospitality or customer service experience A minimum of high school (Grade 12) education No visible tattoos while in Emirates Cabin Crew uniform Salary information: Your salary includes a fixed basic pay and variable flying pay, which is calculated using number of hours you fly during the month. Salaries are paid monthly. What the company offers: Emirates offers career progression opportunities as you grow in knowledge, skills and confidence. From providing the best customer experience in Economy Class to leading the whole team as purser, we always strive to provide our staff with development pathways that matches your personal and professional ambitions. All Emirates Cabin Crew enjoy a wealth of personal benefits. Furnished accommodation is provided free of charge, with utilities being paid for by the company. When you’re on duty, you’ll enjoy free company transport between your accommodation and the airport/training college,

Samenvatting Looking for a logistics job where you can learn quickly and make a real difference? As a Warehouse Employee Supply Chain DHL in Kampen, you’ll join a modern team, receive full training, and help keep the global flow of spare parts moving. Work in a modern warehouse with clear rules, good working conditions, and real opportunities for long-term cooperation. Good work!Over de functieAs a warehouse worker, you will be part of a team responsible for handling and shipping spare parts worldwide. The work is dynamic and physical, ideal for active people who like to stay on the move.
You will work in a 2-shift system:
- 06:00–15:00
- 15:00–23:00
with occasional night shifts (21:00–06:00).

Your main responsibilities include:
- order picking using EPT
- loading and unloading goods

Over het bedrijfDHL Supply Chain is part of the DHL Group and a global leader in logistics and supply chain management. The company operates in over 220 countries, ensuring that millions of shipments reach the right destination on time every day.
At the location in Kampen, you will work in a dynamic and well-organized warehouse environment where teamwork, mutual respect, and trust are highly valued.
Wat wij vragen- private accommodation
- good knowledge of English or Dutch
- willingness to work in shifts
- good physical condition, flexibility, and willingness to learn
- warehouse experience or EPT operation is an advantage

Wat wij bieden- Salary: €15.00 gross per hour
- Shift allowances and overtime paid at 150%
- 2-shift system (06:00–15:00 / 15:00–23:00) + occasional night shifts (21:00–06:00)
- Travel allowance: €0.23/km (up to €9.30 per day)
- 6-week paid training and full onboarding
- Employment with a global logistics leader – DHL
